svg.title: DexJoCo per-task success: GR00T N1.6 fine-tuned vs published pi0.5
svg.desc: Horizontal grouped bars for 11 DexJoCo tasks. Mean success: GR00T N1.6 46.2%, pi0.5 52.5%.

g.text: DexJoCo: my fine-tuned GR00T N1.6 vs. published π0.5 on 11 dexterous tasks

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: Inter, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #98a4b2

g.text: Ahead on 4 of 11 tasks (largest gap: Pinch Tongs +27 points); behind on 7 (largest: Fold Glasses −33, Photograph −31).

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: Inter, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; fill: #98a4b2

g.text: Simulation benchmark. GR00T N1.6: fine-tuned separately per task (256×256 images), 3 evaluation runs × 50 episodes; whiskers = ±1 SD across runs.

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: Inter, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; fill: #98a4b2

g.text: π0.5: numbers reported by the benchmark authors (±1 SD). Different training recipes, so this is a reproduction reference, not a controlled head-to-head.
